results.content: WASHINGTON — Affordability is the runaway top concern for battleground Senate race voters heading into the midterms, and no other issue is even close, a massive grassroots survey found. Focus on affordability dwarfed all other issues that voters raised combined, including immigration, energy, healthcare, crime, education, and national security, according to Americans for Prosperity’s “Americans Unscripted” report shared exclusively with The Post. Over 42,844 voters were sampled on the ground in the seven top Senate races by Americans for Prosperity, a conservative advocacy group, via door knocks and other means.
